method: source reading of the built candidate; every claim below cites a file and line that exists at the observed commit
classification_basis: editor_input_composition.loose_shape = independent_surfaces_over_host_owned_input_path. The macOS system IME owns the input path; the candidate is a consumer of preedit/commit events delivered over it, and owns none of the six deep-integration facets.

evidence: winit's Ime enum carries only Enabled, Preedit(text, range), Commit(text), Disabled — no candidate set crosses the process boundary
src/main.rs:245 comment reads 'Keep the candidate window under the text cursor', i.e. the candidate window is owned by the OS and this process only positions it
input_organ_actually_in_path.root_ui_note: src/root_ui.rs is a 140-line serializing projection of the grid. It has no runtime participation in input, layout or paint.

six_facets.evidence: No candidate handling exists in the candidate's sources. The transport itself cannot carry it: winit's Ime enum has no candidate variant, so the OS renders its own candidate window and the set never reaches this process.

src/main.rs:412 and src/main.rs:424 receive Ime::Enabled and Ime::Disabled but only eprintln! them. No session object and no state machine exist; the only composition state is the String at src/main.rs:107.

src/main.rs:413 destructures Ime::Preedit(text, range); src/main.rs:414 prints range into a diagnostic; src/main.rs:415 stores only text. The composition cursor/selection range inside the preedit is therefore observed and discarded. Rendering at src/gl.rs:151-163.
src/main.rs:417-422 clears the preedit and forwards the committed text to Neovim with '<' escaped as '<lt>'.

src/main.rs:424-427 handles Ime::Disabled by clearing the preedit. That is 'the IME was turned off', not 'the composition was cancelled'. No distinct cancel path exists, so a cancelled composition and a disabled IME are indistinguishable downstream.

src/main.rs:245-257 computes the caret rectangle from grid.cursor (src/grid.rs:37) and the glyph cell size, then hands it to the OS via set_ime_cursor_area. The flow is host -> OS only; no input organ under this project's control receives or shares caret geometry.

adapter_boundary.evidence: IME handling is written inline in the winit event loop at src/main.rs:410-432. There is no port type, no typed event union, and no seam at which an input organ could be substituted.
adapter_boundary.bypass_evidence: src/main.rs is directly coupled to winit's IME, which is directly coupled to the OS organ. This is the direct component-to-input-organ coupling that adapter_no_bypass forbids.
adapter_boundary.additional_finding: src/main.rs:435 drops all KeyboardInput while the preedit string is non-empty. This is a coarse guard rather than a composition-aware input router, and it fails whenever a composition is open but the preedit happens to be empty.

gap_to_deep_integration.summary: The gap is not a missing conversion engine. better-ime already implements five of the six facets; what is missing is ownership of the input path, a host port to carry it, and a candidate surface to render into.

better_ime_existing_surface.selection: rotate() at better_ime/stream.py:118, select(index, learn=True) at :137
better_ime_existing_surface.composition_lifecycle: feed() at :59, feed_text() at :89, reset() at :168
better_ime_existing_surface.caret_geometry: absent, and correctly so — better-ime is a conversion engine and holds no screen geometry
better_ime_existing_surface.other_transports: better_ime/engine.py:37 Engine.convert(alphabet, n_best) for a direct n-best call; better_ime/server.py:126 POST /api/convert for an out-of-process route

required_work: Take ownership of the input path: stop delegating to the OS organ (src/main.rs:300, :387) and route raw key events to the chosen organ instead.
Extract IME mechanics out of src/main.rs into a typed, framework-neutral text-editing host port, so the organ becomes replaceable and adapter_no_bypass can hold.

Render the candidate surface locally. Once the OS organ is out of the path its candidate window disappears, so candidates must be drawn by this project — this is the point at which root-ui and GLSL enter the input path at all.
Make caret geometry bidirectional: Neovim's cursor plus glyph metrics must reach the candidate surface, not only the OS.
Stop discarding the preedit range at src/main.rs:415; a composition caret inside the preedit cannot be drawn without it.
gap_to_deep_integration.risk_recorded: Removing the OS organ from the path removes it for every language, not only for the ones better-ime converts. editor_input_composition.no_sole_organ_assumption forbids treating better-ime as the sole canonical organ without a human gate, so the port must admit more than one organ.

not_concluded.note: This record classifies and measures only. It does not adopt the three-participant composition, does not select an input organ, and does not claim any facet is deep. editor_input_composition.no_partial_deep_claim forbids naming this deep_integration while any facet is absent, and three are.
